[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (numbers : List Int) (seen : Multiset Int) (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  match i with
  | numbers.length => false
  | i + 1 =>
    if seen.contains (-numbers[i]) then
      true
    else
      loop numbers (seen.insert numbers[i]) i + 1
loop numbers ∅ 0
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma multiset_insert_contains
(x : Int) (s : Multiset Int) : s.insert x.contains x :=
by
  simp [Multiset.contains]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation numbers
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_length := numbers.length
have h_spec := spec result
split
-- prove result ↔ exists_zero
have h_left := result
have h_right := exists_zero
-- h_right: 2 ≤ numbers.length ∧ (∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ i < numbers.length ∧ j < numbers.length ∧ sum_i_j i j)
have h_length_ge_2 := h_right.1
have h_exists := h_right.2
-- h_left: result ↔ true or false
have h_left_true := h_left
have h_left_false := h_left
-- case 1: 2 ≤ numbers.length and ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ i < numbers.length ∧ j < numbers.length ∧ sum_i_j i j
by_cases h_length_ge_2': 2 ≤ numbers.length
have h_length_ge_2'' := h_length_ge_2' h_length
have h_i_j := h_exists
let i := h_i_j.1
let j := h_i_j.2
let sum_ij := h_i_j.3
have h_sum_ij := sum_ij
have h_sum_ij := by
  simp [h_sum_ij]
  rw [Int.add_comm]
  linarith
have h_seen := Multiset.empty.insert numbers[i]
  .contains (-numbers[j])
